item.title: Temu commits to complying with EU consumer protection rules following action by national authorities
item.description: European Commission Press release Brussels, 26 Nov 2026 Following a coordinated action by the European Commission and the Consumer Protection Cooperation (CPC) Network, the online marketplace Temu has committed to bring several of its commercial practices in line with EU consumer protection laws. The CPC Network accepted Temu's commitments today.
